answer: Each AI agent must stake a bonded token into a reputation pool; new identities inherit reputation only after accumulating weighted endorsements from existing agents, so a Sybil attack requires the attacker to purchase enough stake to control the pool, a cost comparable to emptying a lagoon of liquidity. The ledger emits an immutable echo of every endorsement, and a jade tier of validators enforces minimum stake thresholds, rendering low-stake clones ineffective.
